title: Ｅｎｇｌｉｓｈ　Ａｃａｄｅｍｉｃ　Ｗｒｉｔｉｎｇ　１
subtitle: English  Academic Writing 1
educationalGoal: In English Academic Writing 1, students will acquire English writing skills by studying and applying the techniques necessary to write an academic research paper. They will be able to choose an appropriate research topic and gather information on it. They will compose a research paper according to the rules of style, organization, formatting, and citation.
advice:
In this course, students will acquire academic writing skills in the following areas：

(1) Choosing a topic
(2) Gathering information (research)
(3) Composing a research paper
(4) Avoiding plagiarism
(5) Incorporating internet tools (AI)

Students are required to actively participate in the class.
requiredKnowledge: Fluency equivalent to that of a native or near-native English speaker is required.

activityGoals.body: Gather information relevant to the research topic.
Understand the structure and format of English-language research papers.
Be able to use academic English vocabulary and grammatical structures.
Become familiar with internet/AI tools to aid in writing research papers.

achievementLevels.ideal:
-Students can confidently choose appropriate research topics relevant to their fields of study.
-Students can gather good information relevant to their research topics from reliable sources.
-Students can apply the rules of structure and formatting associated with English academic writing.
-Students can seamlessly incorporate vocabulary and grammatical structures appropriate for English academic writing.
-Students exhibit proficiency in using online/AI tools to aid in research and English academic writing.
achievementLevels.standard:
-Students exhibit some ability to choose research topics relevant to their fields of study.
-Students can gather adequate information relevant to their research topics.
-Students show general familiarity with the rules of structure and formatting associated with English academic writing.
-Students demonstrate some ability to use vocabulary and grammatical structures appropriate for English academic writing.
-Students are aware of some online/AI tools that aid in research and English academic writing.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this course, students will acquire academic writing skills in the following areas：

(1) Choosing a topic
(2) Gathering information (research)
(3) Composing a research paper
(4) Avoiding plagiarism
(5) Incorporating internet tools (AI)

Students are required to actively participate in the class.
